source_contract.causal_sector: On K5 a causal structure is kappa_ab=sigma_a sigma_b with global sigma reversal redundant; fix sigma_0=+1, giving 16 inequivalent sectors in classes of multiplicity 1,5,10.
source_contract.minimal_spin_edge_factor: Iter307: for j_ab=1/2 the leading local scalar branch factor on an internal edge is -kappa_ab=-sigma_a sigma_b.
source_contract.subset_scope: For a collapsing subset S only internal edges of the induced K_s contribute its leading collapse sign. This audit concerns sign cancellation of the leading local factor, not the full angular/intertwiner residue tensor.

scope_rule: PASS establishes exact causal-sign behavior on K3/K4/K5 collapse strata. It does not prove nonzero contracted residues on every K3/K4, physical admissibility of signed class weights, or cancellation of the full angular/intertwiner distributions.
